# Install `settings-page` — Settings Page

> Adapter-driven account settings shell — section nav (Profile / Preferences / Notifications / Danger zone) + content panel. Consumer owns persistence via a SettingsAdapter.

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt
📦 Slice detail   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/slices/settings-page
🧠 JSON catalog   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/api/knowledge?slice=settings-page
🤖 Prompt page    : https://resource.rahmanef.com/agents/settings-page

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add settings-page
# alias: npx rr add settings-page
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `ui`, `settings`, `account`, `preferences`, `profile`, `adapter`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add settings-page`. Implement `SettingsAdapter` (`load()` once on mount, `save(patch)` per section) over your source of truth, then render `<SettingsShell adapter={adapter} onDeleteAccount={…} />`. `SettingsValues` has three sections: `profile { name, email, avatarUrl?, bio? }`, `preferences { theme, language, density }`, `notifications { emailDigest, productUpdates, mentions, sms }`. `save` receives a partial — only the saved section is present, so shallow-merge. A `createMemoryAdapter(seed?)` is shipped for demos. `active` + `onNavigate` are optional (defaults to internal section state); nav collapses to a Select on mobile.

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
- All Convex queries hit an index (`.withIndex(...)`); never bare `.collect()`.
- Public mutations/queries declare `args:` validators + authz.
- Full ruleset: https://resource.rahmanef.com/best-practice
